name: R0-M3 Droid
description: The R0-M3 Droid was a model of humanoid droid used by the Hutt Cartel on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. A number of R0-M3 units were among the dozens of droids that malfunctioned in the Network Security District and went on a rampage.
